name: io.github.bsayres/heronhex-institutions
title: Higher Ed: Institutions
description: Resolve, profile and compare U.S. colleges from IPEDS and College Scorecard. Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: COLLEGE_SCORECARD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free api.data.gov key (https://api.data.gov/signup). Optional: without it the shared DEMO_KEY is used, which allows only about 10 requests.

environmentVariables.name: HIGHERED_MCPS_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the local cache of downloaded public data (default ~/.cache/highered-mcps).
